determinism.note: sha256 of canonical suite results (tests+stats), compared across two full in-process runs

meta.authorization: lead, 2026-10-17 — local-only, headless; no live providers, no cloud resources, no credentials, no charges, no network

tests.detail: 100 rounds x 2 simultaneous appends at the same head: 100 accepted / 100 rejected; no round produced two winners; losing records never entered the chain (length 101)
tests.name: T1 CAS contention

tests.detail: 20/20 appends with a stale expected-head were rejected by CAS; chain unchanged
tests.name: T2a stale-parent fencing

tests.detail: epoch-blind medium accepts a fresh-parent/stale-epoch record; chain validation rejects it ('stale-epoch' at index 6); last-valid-prefix fallback returns the pre-injection head
tests.name: T2b stale-epoch fencing

tests.detail: 50/50 idempotency keys committed exactly once under apply-then-drop-ack / drop-then-timeout ambiguity; resolution by chain re-read; chain valid
tests.name: T3 ambiguous retries

tests.detail: writer destroyed after an unacknowledged accepted append; restarted writer re-read the chain, found its key already committed (no duplicate), opened a valid successor session (epoch 2), and completed all 30 keys — no gaps, no duplicates
tests.name: T4 crash recovery

tests.detail: good chain validates; 5/5 injected faults (tampered payload, forged signature, duplicate idem-key, stale epoch, parent mismatch) rejected with the correct reasons
tests.name: T5 revision validation
